metric: Q-error of KumoSQL's statistics-only estimator on every connected sub-join of 2+ relations of the 113 JOB queries on full IMDB, against exact sizes. Plan cost (C_out under true sizes) of DPccp plans from these estimates: geomean 1.41x optimal (held-out 1.49x), max 9.8x; from Postgres 16 estimates 2.79x, max 38,079x.
caveats: Families 1-16 were looked at during development; 17-33 held out. The 17-way queries 29a-c contribute over half the sub-joins. 6 MB of statistics. Source: jo-bench at ad516b3.
correctness: Exact sizes by variable elimination in DuckDB. 113 of 113 queries supported, 0 errors.
coverage_of: Failures only: 0 errors over the 71,384 sub-join estimates; equivalence outcomes do not apply.
held_out: Families 17-33 (54 queries): Q-error p50 5.0, p90 815; plan cost geomean 1.49x (Postgres 2.80x)
performance: Pure Python; 1.5 ms per sub-join estimate
